configuration: LUNAR-PCS-01 requirements investigation,not a new near-term LEO rating

power.source_model: 24V catalog-reference motors; peak current conservatively held over full motion times,not measured average service.
power.host_requirement_expression: Continuous allocation >= 12.973W + unallocated service terms; peak allocation >= 21.192W + concurrent unallocated terms. Host24V availability and return/grounding are acceptance inputs,not facts.

requirements.value: Accepted modeled command1–3m/s; actual finite-host relative speeds in this12-shot campaign 0.960300–2.873143m/s.6prograde/6retrograde. Direction is body+X; all retargeting consumes finite slew time.
requirements.acceptance: Imposed source-calibrated point-event mapping; source-rated physical pulse/contact and actual payload release accuracy remain external.

requirements.value: Declared1km osculating-perilune error band: speed3sigma<= 0.192240m/s at the standalone+3m/s reference with10m/0.01m/s navigation sigma and0.1deg pointing sigma. Quantization-only necessary increment<= 0.221980m/s; allocate finer when other speed errors consume budget.
requirements.acceptance: Study requirements only. Independent speed/angle saturation is not a joint guarantee. Measured sensor/control covariance and perturbed campaign Monte Carlo not supplied. The harmonic native host endpoint differs from the open-loop point-gravity planner by about1.63km/1.49m/s,exceeding the assumed10m/0.01m/s navigation bands; full-force navigation/planning/feedback is required before combining the standalone covariance with a campaign precision claim.

requirements.requirement: Finite host control authority and recovery
requirements.value: Surviving tested reference uses20N main thrust,Isp220s,5Nm attitude couple,>= 18.567deg/s rate and declared inertia tensor. Cold-gas couple uses60s Isp and0.5m lever.20s guard,400s loading coast,5s preguard and450s slots are included.
requirements.acceptance: An operational demand,not a supplier capability.5deg/s and double-inertia cases retain missed-slot failures; a real host must demonstrate allocated authority/plume/pointing and resources.

requirements.value: Actual source ACR1 dry156.556720kg including unlocated7kg allowance; loaded204.556720kg. Eight-state geometry box2.250x1.240x1.3489m. Campaign uses280kg complete dry retained core with declared inertia,actual CAD payload coordinates and per-shot updated CG/inertia. Payload axial computational load26.8635N and100N guide sensitivity remain source budgets.
requirements.acceptance: Manufactured mass/CG/inertia,external mounting bolts,launch/environment loads and provider interface approval remain external.

requirements.value: At least5400s from staging campaign start through final nominal release; failed payloads remain captive through abort and independently available disposal. Launch/transfer waiting must be added: ideal Earth–Moon flight is about5days,not a validated retention rating.355s source cycle inside400s coast; captivity/capture precedes prior restraint release.
requirements.acceptance: Current native custody geometry is retained. Physical latch endurance,launch/thermal retention and failed-path clearance tests remain external; no impossible automatic fault reset is claimed.

requirements.value: 64cells32s2p,86.4V internal initial bank.1–3m/s maximum captured pulse 992.126J; known represented service upper envelope 12.973W average/21.192W peak plus named unallocated services.24V is the motor/charger-interface design request.
requirements.acceptance: Host bus quality/isolation,fault current/charger efficiency,standby/brake/lock services and actual circuit/pulse/vacuum acceptance remain external.

requirements.value: Represented thermal upper envelope 12.936W over450s plus unallocated heater/control/actuator terms. Pulse loss and copper/tolerance budgets are source linked. Eaton cell catalog operating range−40..65degC is a reference limit,not space qualification.
requirements.acceptance: Required sink/interface temperatures,radiator view factors,thermal contact/conduction,cycling,outgassing,vacuum friction and contamination acceptance must be measured/agreed. No approved lunar radiator is inferred.

requirements.value: 40kHz source PWM;86.4V internal bank; source-rated current/voltage/ripple design budgets retained. Separate structure/return/bonding and exclusion-zone interfaces must be allocated around the LSM and pulse wiring.
requirements.acceptance: Provider conducted/radiated/transient limits,magnetic cleanliness,shielding/harness/bonding tests and payload susceptibility are missing acceptance inputs,not fabricated compliance.

requirements.value: 12command attempts at450s spacing; successful reference releases12. Modeled pre-command isolated-cell fault yields11releases/1retained; unresolved shared-path fault atslot6 stops after5releases with7retained. Engine-only disposal remains independent of successful releases; surviving campaign leaves 18.233629kg versus8kg reserved floor. Additional actual terminal-state disposal replays for nominal/isolated-cell/shared-path-abort cases all hit the sphere with<= 6.510957kg additional propellant,below8kg,after coasting to apolune and finite attitude preparation.
